products.title: RINZEN Leaf Drop green glass pendant
products.originalTitle: 【ペンダント】葉の雫-ha no shizuku- | 切子

craftClassification.label: Contemporary cut-glass jewelry by RINZEN, listed as kiriko. Individual Edo Kiriko certification is not claimed.

products.size: Glass: W 2.2 × D 0.5 × H 3.3 cm. Chain: approximately 60 cm, as listed on the Japanese page.
products.findings: The chain is listed as surgical stainless steel; the bail and adjuster are plated brass. A specific stainless-steel grade is not stated.
products.editorialSummary: Fresh green glass with a leaf-like outline: an easy color accent for charcoal, navy and a simple white shirt.
products.whoItMaySuit: For someone drawn to green accents and a sculptural pendant rather than a conventional gemstone.
whatToCheck: The listing gives a weight of 10 g without separately describing the weighing scope.
Glass color, thickness, cuts and bail size may vary; the glass is not heat resistant.
products.taxNote: USD display on the English BECOS storefront, checked on the stated date; tax inclusion was not established.

products.title: 6.KILN Blue Bouquet porcelain hoop earrings

craftClassification.label: Porcelain jewelry listed as Imari-Arita Wares; the design uses blue gosu pigment with a needle-drawn bouquet motif. Individual certification is not established.

products.size: Product information table: W 1 × D 1 × H 1.7 cm. The Japanese description separately gives an approximate 3 cm hoop diameter; the table dimensions should not be read as the whole hoop size.
products.findings: The specific product lists porcelain clay, surgical stainless steel and resin. Its exact stainless-steel grade and full component-by-component coverage are not specified.
products.fastening: Post-and-catch pierced earrings with a removable hoop. The official update allows either the integrated or separate catch-and-hoop structure as a matching pair.
products.editorialSummary: A tiny blue bouquet above a clean gold-colored hoop. Try this porcelain pair with white cotton, denim or a soft navy knit.
products.whoItMaySuit: For those who like floral detail, deep blue and the graphic line of a hoop.
whatToCheck: The reverse is transitioning from white to a color matched to the fittings, and the catch-and-hoop construction is changing from integrated to separate. Either matching-pair version may be supplied.
The listed 5 g weight does not identify whether it is per earring or per pair.
The gold-colored surface can scratch or peel if rubbed strongly; the listing recommends gentle care.
products.taxNote: USD display on the English BECOS storefront, checked on the stated date; tax inclusion was not established.

six-kiln-blue-bouquet-pierced-earrings.editorialSummary: 小さな青いブーケに、金色のフープをひとつ。白いコットンやデニム、ネイビーのニットに合わせたい磁器のピアス。
six-kiln-blue-bouquet-pierced-earrings.whoItMaySuit: 深い青と花の繊細さ、フープのすっきりしたかたちを楽しみたい方に。

重さは5gの表記ですが、片耳か一組かは未確認です。
金色の部分は強くこすると傷や剥がれの可能性があり、やさしくお手入れする案内です。

en.headline: A small leaf. A fresh point of green.
en.standfirst: Clear glass opens into a green leaf, with fine cuts and a softly rippled surface. Let it sit against a simple neckline and bring a little color to your day.
highlights: Clear cuts and softly rippled glass
Try charcoal, navy or clean white

outfit.title: Charcoal knit × a green glass leaf
outfit.body: Keep the neckline plain and let the pendant fall over the fabric. A charcoal knit makes the green feel vivid; a white shirt gives it a lighter, more relaxed mood.

ja.headline: 胸もとに、みずみずしい緑を。
ja.standfirst: 透明なガラスに、葉っぱの緑と細かなカット。ゆるやかな凹凸の表情も楽しみながら、無地の服に色をひとつ添えるペンダントです。
highlights: 葉っぱを思わせる、みずみずしいグリーン
透明のカットとゆるやかな凹凸
チャコール・ネイビー・白い服に

outfit.title: チャコールのニット × ガラスの葉
outfit.body: 首まわりはシンプルにして、無地の生地にペンダントを重ねて。チャコールなら緑が鮮やかに、白シャツなら軽快な雰囲気で楽しめます。

en.headline: A blue bouquet, framed by a hoop.
en.standfirst: A tiny floral drawing meets one clean circle. The blue porcelain and gold-colored hoop make an easy accent for a white shirt or a weekend of denim.
highlights: A delicate bouquet drawn in blue porcelain
A removable hoop for two styling options

outfit.title: White cotton × blue porcelain
outfit.body: Try an open-neck white blouse with your hair tucked behind one ear. Add dark denim or navy trousers and keep the rest of your jewelry simple so the small bouquet stays in focus.

ja.headline: 小さな青いブーケを、耳もとに。
ja.standfirst: 青い磁器に描かれた花束と、すっきりした円のフープ。白いシャツにもデニムの日にも、青と金色の組み合わせが表情を添えます。
highlights: 青い磁器に描かれた繊細なブーケ
すっきりした金色のフープ
フープを外しても楽しめる2way

outfit.title: 白いコットン × 青い磁器
outfit.body: 白いブラウスに、髪を片側だけ耳にかけて。デニムやネイビーのパンツを合わせ、ほかのアクセサリーは控えめにすると、小さな花束がコーディネートのポイントになります。

en.headline: Let your wrist make the statement.
en.standfirst: Overlapping gray scales and a silver-colored edge give this porcelain cuff its sculptural rhythm. One strong shape for an otherwise simple outfit.
highlights: Glossy gray porcelain with a scale motif
A sculptural accent for a bare wrist

outfit.title: Black top × one porcelain cuff
outfit.body: Try a short-sleeved black top or roll back the cuff of a crisp shirt. Leave space around the bracelet and let its curved surface be the detail that completes the outfit.

ja.headline: 手首にひとつ、彫刻のような存在感。
ja.standfirst: 重なるグレーの鱗に、銀色の細いアクセント。いつもの服をシンプルにまとめた日に、磁器のかたちを手首で楽しむカフです。
highlights: つやのあるグレーの磁器と鱗のモチーフ
かたちの間にのぞく銀色のアクセント
手首を見せる装いのポイントに

outfit.title: 黒いトップス × 磁器のカフ
outfit.body: 半袖の黒いトップスや、袖をまくった白シャツに。ブレスレットのまわりに余白をつくり、磁器の曲面をひとつのアクセントとして楽しんでください。
